name: ffi_call_js
gaps: call_indirect needs the exact wasm signature, while JS wasmTable.get(fn)(...) tolerates mismatches. Struct by value traps (__builtin_trap), as argument (inet_ntoa(in_addr)) and as result (div -> div_t); JS supports both.
long double traps: sqrtl with c_longdouble (JS passes two i64).
More than 4 arguments when any is float or 64-bit traps: PyOS_double_to_string(double, char, int, int, ptr) (JS ok).
More than 8 integer arguments traps (JS any count).
nfixedargs (variadic calls) and abi are ignored.

name: __syscall_fcntl64
gaps: F_DUPFD/F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC are left to dup (minimum number not honoured; streams, sockets and pipes ENOSYS): the descriptor layer's work, not this step's.
evidence: adapter.c sc_fcntl64: EBADF for a closed descriptor for every command (Pyodide's getStreamFromFD); F_GETLK (12) reports F_UNLCK, F_SETLK/F_SETLKW (13, 14) are granted (one process): fcntl.lockf and flock work; F_GETFD/F_SETFD 0; F_GETFL/F_SETFL for files and sockets; other commands EINVAL. F_DUPFD is dup's (the descriptor layer).

name: __syscall_openat
evidence: adapter.c open_at: the mode of O_CREAT (the variable argument) minus the umask is recorded for a file made now (checked with a stat before the open); an existing file with a recorded mode is opened only if that mode allows the access (EACCES, as Pyodide's mayOpen); a file made now needs the directory to allow write and search (dir_denies); the path record of dup() is malloc'd and has no length limit. The ABI's '..' above the root is clamped in resolve()/fixpath (stat('/..') is the root); cwd + relative paths are composed in growing buffers (no 1024-byte limit, no silent resolution against '/'). O_SYNC/O_DSYNC/O_RSYNC/O_NOATIME are no-ops in Pyodide as well. probe fs_p1/fs_p2 (the audit's fs1/fs2/dir2/fa style) run in the real Pyodide 315.0.0-alpha.2 on Node and in both packagings: open mode, umask, chmod 0 + open -> EACCES, long paths match. '..' after a name is resolved physically (phys(): a path like /l/../../top with l -> a/b gives /top, as Linux; a leading chain of '..' from the cwd or the root is clamped lexically); a dirfd-relative path is left to WASI, and only a '..' out of the descriptor (which cap-std refuses) is walked from the descriptor's recorded path, if that path still names the same directory. dup() reopens the file without any permission check (open_at nocheck), as Linux. Out of memory is ENOMEM where a syscall can say it.

name: _dlopen_js
gaps: No dlerror message: ctypes.CDLL('/nonexistent.so') -> OSError 'dlopen() error' (real: 'could not load dynamic lib: /nonexistent.so ...'). The loader also prints '[loader] instantiate failed' to stderr, twice for each ctypes attempt.
RTLD_LOCAL is not honoured: the GOT of a later library resolves against every library already loaded.

name: __syscall_statfs64

name: __syscall_symlinkat
gaps: A link in one preopen to an absolute target in another (a --mount) gives EXDEV, where Linux symlink(2) never fails that way. The reason is the platform's: wasmtime/cap-std refuses an ABSOLUTE target (EPERM) and cannot follow ANY link, even a relative one, from one preopen directory into another, so no target string stored in the host file can make the link work; making the link without a working target would be a dangling fake. (Links within one preopen, absolute or relative, work.)
evidence: adapter.c sc_symlinkat/rel_target: wasmtime refuses an absolute target (EPERM), so the link is made with the target relative to the link's real directory (phys()) and the original string is kept in the metadata table: readlink returns exactly what the program stored, lstat's size is its length, opening through the link reaches the same file; rename makes the link again for its new directory (relink), copytree(symlinks=True) round-trips. The directory of the new link must allow write and search (EACCES). A link and a target under different preopens (a --mount) cannot be expressed: EXDEV. Relative targets are stored as they are. Targets are stored relative to the link's real directory; a directory renamed later has the stored absolute links inside it made again (relink_tree, skipped when no such link exists).
